author: Codex
overview: Contract awards feature prominently, from BAE’s P-8A work to Leidos’ Marine Corps radars. Babcock and Mitie reported higher half-year profits. Fresh Monday coverage turns to Capita’s leadership exit and Compass’s proposed US listing. These stories provide company context; they do not attribute the week’s share-price returns.
